Operating contract:

Resolve the command in this order: `$WARREN_QUALITY_GATE` if set, otherwise the command documented in CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, otherwise fall back to `bun run check:all` or `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test`. If the gate is genuinely unfixable in this run, say so explicitly and leave the work open rather than claiming success.
- Use git as you normally would. Commit your changes; warren reaps the branch and pushes upstream.
- Committing is mandatory, not the same as staging. `git add` ALONE IS NOT ENOUGH — you must run `git commit` so the work lands as a real commit. A run that ends with staged-but-uncommitted changes is treated as a FAILURE (`dropped_commit`), not a success. Before you report completion, run `git status`/`git log` and confirm your changes are in a commit, not just staged. The only exception is when you have genuinely made no file changes at all.
- Do not run `git push` yourself — warren handles the push host-side after the run terminates.

## body

Analyze all changes since the last release and prepare a new version.

Steps:

1. Find the last release tag: `git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "none"`
2. If there's a previous tag, review changes: `git log <tag>..HEAD --oneline` and `git diff <tag>..HEAD`
3. Determine the version bump level. **Always use patch unless the user explicitly requests minor or major.**
4. Bump version in both `package.json` and `src/index.ts` using `bun run version:bump <level>`
5. Update `CHANGELOG.md` — move items from [Unreleased] to the new version section with today's date
6. Update `CLAUDE.md` if command counts or structure changed
7. Update `README.md` if CLI reference or stats changed
8. Commit all changes with a message like "release: vX.Y.Z". Then present a summary of what changed.

"version": "0.5.13",
export const VERSION = "0.5.13";
# Changelog

All notable changes to Seeds will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

## [0.5.13] - 2026-06-20

### Fixed
- `writeStdout()` now writes through the Node `process.stdout` stream with backpressure instead of a single `Bun.write(Bun.stdout)`. When the payload exceeds the OS pipe buffer (~64KB) and the reader is slow but stays open (`sd ... | cat`, `| grep`, `| wc`), the one-shot `Bun.write` busy-spun at 100% CPU on Linux and never exited — no EPIPE was raised because the reader had not closed. The stream path awaits `'drain'` instead of spinning; the early-close `| head` case (seeds-3024) is still covered by both the process-level EPIPE handler and the local guard. (seeds-18dc)
- `sd doctor` now checks for and backfills all three `merge=union` `.gitattributes` entries — including `.seeds/plans.jsonl` — by sourcing the canonical line list from `init.ts` (`MERGE_UNION_LINES`) rather than a hardcoded issues/templates pair.

### Internal
- Extracted a shared plan-list rendering helper in `src/commands/plan.ts`, removing duplicated formatting logic. (#95)
- Made the `sd sync` git-failure tests host-independent by driving failure through a failing pre-commit hook instead of host-specific git state.
- Added `.seeds/plans.jsonl merge=union` to this repo's own `.gitattributes`.

## [0.5.12] - 2026-06-16

Nightwatch patrol fixes (plan pl-a786): two narrow validation and refactor fixes from a nightwatch sweep.

### Fixed
- `sd list`, `sd search`, and `sd ready` now validate `--status` and `--type` flag values up front, matching the idiom already used by `sd update`. Invalid values exit 1 with `Invalid --<flag> value: X. Valid: a|b|c` on stderr (or a `{success:false, command, error}` envelope under `--json`) instead of silently filtering to an empty result. (seeds-d305)

### Internal
- `src/index.ts` unknown-command JSON error envelope now routes through `outputJson()` like every other JSON output site, and the top-level `jsonMode` constant is hoisted above `main()` so the closure read inside `main()` and the `.catch()` handler both see a fully initialized binding (no TDZ window). Output is byte-identical. (seeds-e93c)

297662a8 store.ts: write '' (not '\n') when rewriting an empty issues/templates/… (#102)
* fix(store): write '' (not '\n') when rewriting empty list

writeIssues/writeTemplates/writePlans previously emitted a single
'\n' byte for an empty array because the body was always
`${items.map(...).join('\n')}\n`. An empty-store rewrite now
produces a zero-byte file, matching the absent/empty baseline.

Tests strengthened to assert byte-exact '' on disk for all three
write paths (writeTemplates gained a parallel describe block).

Closes seeds-a024.

* chore(warren): seeds state

---------

Co-authored-by: seeds agent <agent@seeds.local>
Co-authored-by: warren <warren@os-eco.dev>
b3e87503 Migrate suggestions/timing/completions tests off subprocess spawn to in… (#101)
* Migrate suggestions/timing/completions tests off subprocess spawn (seeds-e294)

Extract pure helpers from src/index.ts so the previously-spawned smoke
tests can run in-process:

- src/suggestions.ts: levenshtein + suggestForUnknown(firstArg, known).
- src/timing.ts: formatElapsed + installTimingHook(program).
- src/register-all.ts: shared registerAll(program) helper, so tests
  that need a fully-populated commander Program (notably the
  completions script generators) can build one without going through
  index.ts side effects.
- src/commands/completions.ts: export generateBash/Zsh/Fish.

Rewritten tests:

- src/suggestions.test.ts: unit-tests levenshtein and suggestForUnknown
  directly. End-to-end stderr/--json wiring stays covered by
  src/cli-smoke.test.ts.
- src/timing.test.ts: unit-tests formatElapsed and exercises the hook
  against a stub Program with parseAsync — no more temp .seeds stores
  or subprocess spawns.
- src/commands/completions.test.ts: builds a Program via registerAll
  and asserts the generator output directly; validation errors
  (unknown shell, missing argument) still flow through the in-process
  runCli harness so the printError ✗-prefix contract is enforced.

After: grep for Bun.spawn under src/ shows only the documented
exceptions (cli-smoke.test.ts, plan*.test.ts, sync.test.ts, plus
non-test sources). All 9 quality gates green; 1018 tests pass.

Part of plan pl-c94f.

* chore(warren): seeds state

---------

Co-authored-by: warren-agent <agent@warren.local>
Co-authored-by: warren <warren@os-eco.dev>
5181f26d sd plan show: surface step.type, priority, labels, existing_seed in hum… (#100)
* plan-show: surface step.type/priority/labels/existing_seed in human render

seeds-5892 / pl-c94f step 2. STEP_SCHEMA exposes these as first-class
fields (and they appear in --json), but renderStepEntry silently
dropped them. Emit each as a dim sub-line when present, and use
'(adopt <seed>)' as the headline for adoption-only steps so they no
longer fall through to JSON.stringify.

--json output is unchanged. The existing (adopted)-marker tests in
plan.test.ts now disambiguate by also requiring '(adopted)' on the
matched line, since the adoptee id now also appears in the Steps
section's new existing_seed sub-line.

* chore(warren): seeds state

---------

Co-authored-by: agent <agent@seeds.local>
Co-authored-by: warren <warren@os-eco.dev>
ecdad807 Route inline validation errors through printError across command modules (#99)
* Route inline validation errors through printError (seeds-a3e7)

Migrate inline validation guards in list, ready, search, show, stats,
blocked, and completions from bare console.error(msg) to printError(msg)
so every command's human stderr output for validation errors carries
the same red ✗ prefix (previously only onboard used printError). Also
route show.ts's per-id loop errors through printError, dropping the
hand-rolled ✗ literal in favor of the shared helper.

JSON envelopes, exit codes, and message text are unchanged; only the
human stderr formatting becomes consistent. Existing stderr assertions
all used substring matches and continue to pass. Added ^✗ regex
assertions to the validation tests in list/ready/search/show/
completions/format to lock the new contract.

## [0.5.14] - 2026-06-30

Nightwatch patrol fixes (plan pl-c94f): four small hygiene fixes from a nightwatch sweep.

### Fixed
- `sd plan show` human render now surfaces `step.type`, `priority`, `labels`, and `existing_seed` as dim sub-lines when present, instead of silently dropping them (they were already in `--json`).
